scripts.text:
[Sratos]
Hello, dear customer who walked in, let's hope for a miracle today.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[斯拉托斯]
歡迎光臨，尊貴的顧客。
希望今天能創造奇蹟。
請問有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text: Enhance the equipment's grade.
scripts.translation: 提升裝備等級

scripts.text: Exchange Etel items
scripts.translation: 兌換伊特魯物品

scripts.text: What is Grade Enhancement?
scripts.translation: 什麼是等級提升？

scripts.text:
[Sratos]
Our customer. You want to enhance the grade of equipment.
It is not easy to move the magical power of jewels.
scripts.translation:
[斯拉托斯]
尊貴的顧客，您想要提升裝備的等級。
引導寶石中的魔力並非易事。

scripts.text:
[Sratos]
Magical power can explode on the spot.
Then the weapon that will inherit the magical power also explodes!
scripts.translation:
[斯拉托斯]
魔力可能會當場爆發。
那麼，承載魔力的武器也會隨之爆炸！

scripts.text: I'll still do it!
scripts.translation: 我還是要試試！

scripts.text: I'll think about it.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Sratos]
I wish good luck to our courageous customers!
scripts.translation:
[斯拉托斯]
祝我們勇敢的顧客好運！

scripts.text:
[Sratos]
Whenever you have the courage to challenge, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[斯拉托斯]
當您再次鼓起勇氣挑戰時，請隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Sratos]
These are jewels used to enhance grades.
Etel Dust, the jewels that will be the base, and if you give me a small fee I'll exchange it for Etel jewels.
scripts.translation:
[斯拉托斯]
這些是用於提升等級的寶石。
伊特魯粉塵是基礎材料，如果您支付少量費用，我可以將其兌換為伊特魯寶石。

scripts.text:
[Sratos]
Occasionally, unstable jewels with a lot of pure magical power are found.
We call these etheric gems, right?
scripts.translation:
[斯拉托斯]
偶爾會發現含有大量純淨魔力的不穩定寶石。
我們稱之為以太寶石，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sratos]
You can transfer the magical power of the etheric gem to other weapons, but of course there is some risk.
It's delicate, so if you aren't careful, pop! It will explode.
scripts.translation:
[斯拉托斯]
您可以將以太寶石的魔力轉移到其他武器上，但當然存在一定風險。
過程很精細，如果不小心，砰！就會爆炸。

scripts.text:
[Sratos]
Anyway, if you use this etheric gem, you can enhance the weapon you are using.
Performance gets better. We call this grade enhancement.
scripts.translation:
[斯拉托斯]
總之，使用這種以太寶石，您可以提升正在使用的武器。
效能會得到提升。我們稱之為等級提升。

scripts.text:
[Sratos]
You too, wouldn't you be happy if the weapons you love grow one step further?
We are the people who assist it. It's a bit risky, though. ahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[斯拉托斯]
您也一樣，如果心愛的武器能更進一步，您不會感到高興嗎？
我們是協助您的人。雖然有點風險，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Suribell]
May good luck always be with you!
Welcome to Paramarket's Grade Enhancement Center~
scripts.translation:
[蘇里貝爾]
願好運永遠伴隨您！
歡迎來到帕拉市場的等級提升中心~

scripts.text: Enhance the equipment's grade.
scripts.translation: 提升裝備等級

scripts.text: Exchange Etel items
scripts.translation: 兌換伊特魯物品

scripts.text: What is Grade Enhancement?
scripts.translation: 什麼是等級提升？

scripts.text:
[Suribell]
Do you want to unlock the potential of your favorite equipment?
Explosions may also occur in the process of dealing with magical powers.
scripts.translation:
[蘇里貝爾]
您想釋放最愛裝備的潛力嗎？
在處理魔力的過程中，也可能會發生爆炸。

scripts.text:
[Suribell]
Still, if you're trying to enhance your grade... !
I, Suribell, will do my best!
scripts.translation:
[蘇里貝爾]
不過，如果您想提升等級...！
我，蘇里貝爾，會全力以赴的！

scripts.text: I'll still do it!
scripts.translation: 我還是要試試！

scripts.text: I'll think about it.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Suribell]
Let's hold hands and have faith! Try clenching your teeth!
scripts.translation:
[蘇里貝爾]
讓我們手牽手，保持信任！試著咬緊牙關！

scripts.text:
[Suribell]
Okay! Let's drink a glass of cold water!
scripts.translation:
[蘇里貝爾]
好的！讓我們喝杯冷水冷靜一下！

scripts.text:
[Suribell]
You need etheric gems to enhance grades!
If you combine Etel Dust and jewels to make it, it is fine! An Etel jewel for adventurers is complete!
Would you like to combine jewels and Etel Dust?
scripts.translation:
[蘇里貝爾]
提升等級需要以太寶石！
將伊特魯粉塵和寶石結合製作即可！對冒險者來說，伊特魯寶石就完美了！
您想結合寶石和伊特魯粉塵嗎？

scripts.text:
[Suribell]
Occasionally, unstable jewels with a lot of pure magical power are found.
I decided to call such gems etheric gems.
Who? I am Suribell!
scripts.translation:
[蘇里貝爾]
偶爾會發現蘊含大量純粹魔力的不穩定寶石。
我決定將這種寶石稱為以太寶石。
誰？我是蘇里貝爾！

scripts.text:
[Suribell]
The magical power of etheric gems sometimes awakens the hidden potential of equipment.
We call it grade enhancement because it goes up one tier!
scripts.translation:
[蘇里貝爾]
以太寶石的魔力有時會喚醒裝備的隱藏潛力。
我們稱之為等級提升，因為它會提升一個等級！

scripts.text:
[Suribell]
The adventurer may have a potential that is unknown to him.
There is a risk that it can be destroyed if done wrong, but try it with faith!
scripts.translation:
[蘇里貝爾]
冒險者可能擁有連自己都不知道的潛力。
如果操作不當，有被破壞的風險，但請懷著信任去嘗試吧！
